text: The micro-batcher is one asyncio task per worker. Never call session.run() on the event loop, it blocks for 40-200ms and every other request waits. Use `await loop.run_in_executor(self._pool, ...)` with the dedicated single-thread pool.
ONNX InferenceSession is created per request in predict.py; it's cheap (<5ms) for the small model.
Building an InferenceSession for the v4 model takes ~1.2s because of graph optimizations. Create one per worker in the lifespan handler and keep it on app.state.onnx.
Batcher tests: pytest-asyncio in auto mode. Use the fake_clock fixture from tests/conftest.py instead of asyncio.sleep, otherwise the max_wait tests flake under xdist.
uv for everything: `uv sync`, `uv run pytest -q`. Don't pip install into .venv, uv.lock will drift and CI fails on `uv lock --check`.
Setup: `poetry install`, then `poetry run pytest`.

Gunicorn timeout is 30s but the ALB idle timeout is 60s. If a batch hangs, gunicorn kills the worker and the client sees a 502, not a timeout, so 502 spikes in the ALB logs usually mean stuck inference.

When the queue is full, return 503 with an integer Retry-After (seconds). The mobile client backs off on it. We tried 429 first and the client treated it as per-user throttling and retried immediately.
Alembic: `uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "..."`. Autogenerate misses server_default changes on Enum columns, read the generated file before committing.
Model registry sync (app/registry/sync.py) pulls new model versions from S3 every 10 minutes and compares ETags, so re-uploading the same file doesn't trigger a reload.
Feature store lookups go through a Redis cache with a 5-minute TTL, keys `fs:{entity}:{id}:v2`. Bump the suffix when the feature schema changes.
GPU image is based on nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime because onnxruntime-gpu 1.16 needs CUDA 11.

Dockerfile.gpu is on CUDA 12.4 + cuDNN 9 for onnxruntime-gpu 1.20. If the CUDA provider silently falls back to CPU, run `python -c "import onnxruntime as ort; print(ort.get_available_providers())"` inside the container.

Settings use pydantic-settings in app/core/settings.py with the VESPER_ env prefix (VESPER_BATCH_MAX_WAIT_MS). When you change a default, also update deploy/helm/values.yaml, it overrides the code default in every env.
One AsyncSession per request via Depends(get_session). Sharing it across asyncio.gather calls raises 'concurrent operations are not permitted'.
pre-commit runs ruff format, ruff check and mypy --strict on app/. `uv run pre-commit run -a` before pushing.
API keys are stored argon2-hashed in api_keys; the plaintext is shown once at creation. Rotation endpoint: POST /admin/keys/{id}/rotate.

Load test ke liye `uv run locust -f loadtests/predict.py --headless -u 200 -r 20` chalao aur p99 Grafana ke 'vesper-batching' panel mein dekho. Laptop pe CPU provider ke numbers kisi kaam ke nahi, staging GPU node pe chalao.
/explain runs SHAP on CPU (~3s per call) and has its own rate limit in app/api/routes/explain.py.
Branch names feat/, fix/, chore/. The PR title becomes the squash commit, keep it under 72 chars.
Training-serving skew report runs nightly (jobs/skew_report.py), comparing request-log feature distributions to the training set; alerts go to #ml-alerts.
Deploy is the GitHub Actions deploy workflow running helm upgrade. Canary at 10% for 30 min, watch error rate and p95 before promoting.
TensorRT EP wants batch sizes padded to a multiple of 8; a batch of 13 falls back to the slow path. The batcher pads with zero rows and drops them from the output.
Tokenizer files repo mein commit mat karo, build time pe S3 se aate hain (scripts/fetch_assets.sh).
default_response_class is ORJSONResponse. numpy arrays and numpy floats must be converted with .tolist() first or serialization raises TypeError.
